name: free-image-to-video
title: Free Image to Video: Image to Video AI with Sound
description: Free image to video AI with no daily cap: start with no sign-up, keep going on a free account. Every video comes with sound and no watermark. This Actor turns a photo or a prompt into a clip with sound on your own Free Image to Video API key.

output.title: Generated video
output.description: One dataset row per run with the video URL, or the error when the run failed.

videos.title: Generated video
videos.description: Dataset rows: prompt, imageUrl, scene, options, taskId, status, videoUrl, and error / errorKind when the run failed.
